dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, high-frequency jagged perimeters of off-white 'O' and 'C' structures against a dark charcoal base, showing sharp pixel-level transitions on the upper dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized, bright-white pixel clusters concentrated along the superior dorsal ridge, with decreasing spatial frequency toward the lateral midsection.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal-anterior annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle; four smaller high-intensity blobs on the mid-lateral flank define an irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: Cluster of high-reflectance, linear, tapering structures (vibrissae) extending from the superior-anterior margin.
